# Refinery29

> > Refinery29 is a leading digital media and entertainment platform delivering progressive content on pop culture, streaming, LGBTQ+ issues, and lifestyle across multiple languages.

Refinery29 provides in-depth entertainment coverage including Netflix series analysis (Élite, Shadow and Bone, Halston), film reviews, and cultural commentary. The platform serves both English and German-speaking audiences with content spanning TV series breakdowns, queer culture guides, and seasonal lifestyle features.

## Key Topics

- Netflix original series and streaming content
- LGBTQ+ culture and terminology
- Pop culture analysis and entertainment news
- TV series reviews and recaps
- Film analysis and cinema coverage
- Queer representation in media
- German-language lifestyle content
- Shadow and Bone and Six of Crows adaptations
- Halston and fashion documentaries
- Lesbian slang and gay lingo
- Coming out resources
- Streaming platform reviews
- Cultural commentary and social issues
- Holiday and seasonal content
- Celebrity and entertainment personalities

## Entertainment & Streaming

- [TV, Stars, Kino & Kunst auf Refinery29.de](https://www.refinery29.com/de-de/entertainment?page=7): German entertainment coverage: Netflix shows, film, culture & streaming

## LGBTQ+ Culture & Community

- [Lesbian Slang Terms, Gay Lingo Used By LGBT Community](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/lesbian-slang-terms-definitions): Guide to lesbian slang and LGBT terminology for queer culture

## Lifestyle & Seasonal Content

- [Weihnachten](https://www.refinery29.com/de-de/weihnachten?page=3): German Christmas content: gift guides, recipes, and holiday decor tips
